document: OpenDataRemoval Privacy Platform — Celery Task Catalogue

design_decisions.failure_escalation: Tasks retry up to max_retries then set request status to requires_manual and create dashboard notification
design_decisions.scan_dispatch: Batched parallel — 10 brokers per batch per profile via Celery chord. Profiles processed in parallel. Completion chord callback triggers post-scan analytics.
design_decisions.legal_letters: CCPA/GDPR PDFs generated via WeasyPrint, stored on opendataremoval_screenshots volume, file path written to audit record, then emailed as attachment
design_decisions.post_scan_analytics: Celery chord callback — fires score_computation and snapshot_generation tasks automatically when all scan tasks in the chord complete
design_decisions.idempotency: All tasks keyed to prevent duplicate execution — same (profile_id, broker_id, date) never creates duplicate scan results or requests
design_decisions.audit_first: All outbound actions write to audit.audit_log before executing — if audit write fails the action does not proceed

beat_schedule.description: Periodic tasks scheduled by Celery Beat running in the beat service container

tasks.description: Trigger full household scan at 02:00 daily
Delete screenshot files older than SCREENSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS
Verify all active broker opt-out URLs are reachable — flag unreachable ones
Find removal requests with next_action_at in the past and dispatch follow-up tasks

scanning.description: Tasks that execute broker scans and post-scan analytics

dispatch_daily_scan.description: Entry point for the daily full scan. Creates a scan_run record, then dispatches one dispatch_profile_scan task per active non-paused profile in parallel.

outputs.scan_run_id: UUID of the created scan_run record

implementation_notes: Create scan_run row with run_type=daily_full, status=pending
Fetch all active non-paused profiles
Dispatch group([dispatch_profile_scan.s(profile_id, scan_run_id) for each profile])
Update scan_run status to running
Write audit_log: scan_started

retry_policy.note: Orchestrator only — individual scan tasks handle their own retries

dispatch_daily_scan.on_failure: Write audit_log scan_failed, create system_alert notification

dispatch_profile_scan.description: Dispatches broker scan tasks for a single profile in batches of 10. Uses a Celery chord so post-scan analytics fire automatically when all batches complete.
implementation_notes: Fetch all active brokers (is_active=True)
Split into batches of 10
chord(group([scan_broker.s(profile_id, broker_id, scan_run_id) for each broker in batch]) | compute_post_scan_analytics.s(profile_id, scan_run_id))
Update scan_run.total_brokers

scan_broker.description: Executes a single broker scan for a single profile via the Playwright microservice. Creates or updates a scan_result row. If result_status=found, creates an exposure and dispatches execute_removal_request.

outputs.result_status: found | not_found | inconclusive | captcha_blocked | rate_limited | error

implementation_notes: Fetch active playbook for broker_id
Fetch decrypted profile fields for profile_id
POST to PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL/scan with playbook + field tokens
Create scan_result row with result
If result_status=found: create exposures row, dispatch execute_removal_request.delay(profile_id, broker_id, exposure_id)
If result_status=captcha_blocked: update broker.captcha_required=True, create action_required notification
Update scan_run.completed_brokers += 1
Publish SSE event to Redis pub/sub channel scan:{scan_run_id}
scan_broker.on_max_retries: Set result_status=error, increment scan_run.failed_brokers, write audit_log

compute_post_scan_analytics.description: Chord callback — fires automatically when all broker scan tasks for a profile complete. Computes daily exposure score and writes broker snapshots to reporting schema.

inputs.scan_results: List of scan_result dicts (passed by chord)

implementation_notes: Count active exposures for profile_id
Compute score = ROUND(100 - (active / NULLIF(max_ever, 0)) * 100, 1)
Insert reporting.exposure_scores row
Insert reporting.daily_broker_snapshots rows for all brokers
Refresh reporting.field_exposure_summary for this profile
If scan_run all profiles complete: update scan_run.status=completed, write audit_log scan_completed
Create new_exposure notifications for any newly detected exposures

dispatch_verification_scan.description: Scheduled via Celery ETA. Runs a targeted single-broker scan to independently verify a broker has actually removed the profile after confirming removal.
dispatch_verification_scan.triggered_by: Celery ETA — scheduled when removal_request.status transitions to confirmed_removed (default 14 days after confirmation)
implementation_notes: Create scan_run row with run_type=verification
Execute scan_broker for this profile/broker pair
If not_found: update verification_scan.outcome=verified_removed, update request.status=verified_removed, write audit_log
If found: update verification_scan.outcome=still_listed, create relisting_events row, dispatch execute_removal_request again, create relisting_detected notification
Update verification_scan.completed_at

requests.description: Tasks that execute removal request workflows

execute_removal_request.description: Orchestrates the full removal workflow for a single profile+broker exposure. Selects the correct removal method and dispatches the appropriate sub-task. Creates the removal_request row if it does not already exist.

inputs.parent_request_id: UUID — optional, set for re-listing requests

implementation_notes: Fetch broker.removal_method
Create or fetch removal_request row (idempotent on exposure_id)
Write audit_log BEFORE dispatching — event_type=removal_initiated
Dispatch method task: web_form → submit_web_form_optout, email → send_removal_email, ccpa/gdpr → generate_and_send_legal_letter, manual → create_manual_action_item
Schedule follow-up ETA: followup_removal_request.apply_async(eta=now + broker.estimated_response_days * 86400)
Update request.next_action_at
execute_removal_request.idempotency_key: exposure_id — one active request per exposure

submit_web_form_optout.description: Uses the Playwright microservice to execute the broker's web form opt-out playbook. Captures confirmation screenshot.
implementation_notes: Fetch active playbook for broker
Fetch decrypted profile fields
POST to PLAYWRIGHT_SERVICE_URL/optout with playbook + fields
On confirmation detected: update request.status=pending_confirmation, write audit_log removal_submitted
On captcha_blocked: update request.status=requires_manual, update broker.captcha_required=True, create action_required notification
Store screenshot in scanning.screenshots linked to request audit record

send_removal_email.description: Composes and sends a removal request email from the dedicated removal mailbox. Renders Jinja2 template (broker-specific or generic fallback). Logs sent email to audit record.
implementation_notes: Fetch broker email_template (broker-specific first, generic fallback)
Render Jinja2 template with decrypted profile tokens
Send via SMTP with profile data as subject context
Store SMTP Message-ID for Mailwatcher correlation
Write audit_log: removal_email_sent BEFORE smtp.sendmail()
Update request.status=pending_confirmation, request.submitted_at=now()

generate_and_send_legal_letter.description: Generates a CCPA or GDPR legal deletion request letter as a PDF using WeasyPrint, stores the file, attaches it to an outbound email, and sends it. File path written to audit record.
implementation_notes: Render Jinja2 legal template with decrypted profile fields
Generate PDF via WeasyPrint — save to opendataremoval_screenshots volume
Record pdf_path in audit_log detail JSON
Write audit_log: legal_letter_generated BEFORE sending
Send email with PDF as attachment via SMTP
Update request.status=pending_confirmation, request.submitted_at=now()

followup_removal_request.description: Scheduled via Celery ETA. Fires when broker has not responded within their stated response window. Sends a follow-up using the same method as the original. Maximum 3 follow-ups before escalating to requires_manual.
followup_removal_request.triggered_by: Celery ETA — set at request creation time (broker.estimated_response_days, default 30 days)
implementation_notes: Fetch request — if status is confirmed_removed, verified_removed, or requires_manual: skip (already resolved)
If followup_number <= 3: create followups row, re-dispatch appropriate method task (send_removal_email or submit_web_form_optout)
Update request.followup_count += 1
Schedule next follow-up ETA if followup_number < 3
If followup_number == 3: after dispatch set next check to 30 days, if still unresolved → set status=requires_manual, create action_required notification
followup_removal_request.escalation: After 3 follow-ups with no response: status=requires_manual, create action_required notification with full request context

process_due_followups.description: Hourly sweep that finds any removal_requests with next_action_at in the past that were not triggered by their ETA task (e.g. worker was down). Safety net for missed ETA dispatches.
implementation_notes: SELECT id, followup_count FROM requests.removal_requests WHERE next_action_at <= now() AND status IN (pending_confirmation, submitted) AND followup_count < 3
For each: dispatch followup_removal_request.delay(request_id, followup_count + 1)
Log count to system_events

process_email_classification.description: Triggered by Mailwatcher after classifying an inbound email. Updates the corresponding removal_request status based on classification result.
process_email_classification.triggered_by: Mailwatcher service via direct API call to POST /api/webhooks/mail-classification (internal only)

inputs.request_id: UUID — may be None if unmatched

implementation_notes: confirmed_removal: update request.status=confirmed_removed, request.confirmed_at=now(), schedule dispatch_verification_scan ETA (14 days), create removal_confirmed notification
rejection: update request.status=failed, create action_required notification with raw email body
info_requested: update request.status=requires_manual, create action_required notification with raw email body attached
unclassified: create action_required notification with raw email body for human review
Write audit_log: email_response_processed for all classifications

purge_expired_screenshots.description: Nightly task. Finds screenshot files past their purge_at date, deletes the files from the opendataremoval_screenshots volume, and stamps purged_at on the row. The database row is retained for audit trail.
implementation_notes: SELECT id, file_path FROM scanning.screenshots WHERE purge_at <= now() AND purged_at IS NULL
For each: os.remove(file_path) — skip with warning if file not found
UPDATE scanning.screenshots SET purged_at=now() WHERE id=...
Write system_events row with bytes_freed total

compute_disk_usage.description: Hourly task that measures disk usage of all opendataremoval volumes and caches the result in Redis for the /api/system/health endpoint.
implementation_notes: Use shutil.disk_usage() per volume mount point
Cache result in Redis key opendataremoval:disk_usage with 70-minute TTL
/api/system/health reads from this Redis key

check_broker_opt_out_urls.description: Weekly task. For each active broker with a web form removal method, performs a lightweight HTTP HEAD request to the opt_out_url to verify it is reachable. Flags unreachable brokers.
implementation_notes: Fetch all active brokers WHERE removal_method=web_form AND opt_out_url IS NOT NULL
For each: HTTP HEAD to opt_out_url with 10s timeout
If 4xx/5xx or timeout: update broker.last_verified_at, add note to broker.notes, create system_alert notification
If 2xx/3xx: update broker.last_verified_at
Write system_events row with summary

upsert_broker_from_discovery.description: Called by the /api/webhooks/n8n handler for each broker in an n8n discovery payload. Upserts by canonical_domain. Validates playbook_json against JSON Schema before inserting.

inputs.broker_data: dict — full broker payload from n8n

implementation_notes: Upsert registry.brokers ON CONFLICT (canonical_domain) DO UPDATE only changed fields
If playbook_json present: validate against JSON Schema, if valid insert new broker_playbooks version with is_active=True
Write audit_log: broker_registry_upsert with source field
Return action taken for webhook response aggregation

create_notification.description: Creates a notification row in auth.notifications and publishes the event to the Redis pub/sub channel for WebSocket fanout to connected dashboard clients.
create_notification.triggered_by: Any task that needs to surface information to the dashboard
implementation_notes: INSERT auth.notifications row
Publish to Redis channel opendataremoval:notifications:{household_id} via redis.publish()
WebSocket handler fans out to all connected clients for this household

generate_export_report.description: Triggered for large report exports (>10k rows). Generates the file in the background and creates a notification with a download link when complete.
generate_export_report.triggered_by: GET /api/reports/export when row count exceeds threshold
implementation_notes: Query reporting schema with filters
For PDF: render via WeasyPrint to opendataremoval_screenshots volume
For CSV: write to temp file on opendataremoval_logs volume
Generate signed time-limited download token (JWT with file_path claim, 1h TTL)
Dispatch create_notification with download_url

task_dependency_map.description: Shows how tasks chain and trigger each other

sequence: dispatch_profile_scan → chord(group([scan_broker x 10 per batch]) | compute_post_scan_analytics)
execute_removal_request → submit_web_form_optout OR send_removal_email OR generate_and_send_legal_letter
If still_listed → execute_removal_request (new request with parent_request_id set)
Hourly process_due_followups acts as safety net for missed ETAs

orchestrators.note: Dispatch/orchestrator tasks do not retry — child tasks handle their own retries

retry_policy_defaults.final_escalation: All tasks that reach max_retries set request.status=requires_manual and dispatch create_notification with notification_type=action_required

audit_log_events.description: event_type values written to audit.audit_log by Celery tasks

redis_channels.description: Redis pub/sub channels used for real-time communication

channels.subscriber: /api/system/health endpoint (reads from Redis key not channel)

celery_canvas_patterns.daily_scan_chord: chord(group([scan_broker.s(p_id, b_id, run_id) for b_id in batch]) | compute_post_scan_analytics.s(profile_id, run_id))
celery_canvas_patterns.profile_group: group([dispatch_profile_scan.s(p_id, run_id) for p_id in active_profiles])
